title: TRIAD Guard: decision-support prototype for the TRIAD-QEHS framework
description:
Single-file HTML prototype that implements the readiness gate, live re-gating, route risk, QEHS performance index and maturity score of the TRIAD-QEHS framework for integrated journey, driver and vehicle management in chemical road transport.

It accompanies the review paper 'One journey, one system: integrated safety management of chemical road transport'. Route, fleet and segment values are illustrative or synthetic, weights and thresholds are initial proposals, and the prototype has not been field-tested.
